record.question: Consider the following statements: Five roommates namely Rose, Daisy, Lily, Violet and Jasmine, each do one house keeping task of mopping, sweeping, laundry, vacuuming or dusting, one day a week, Monday through Friday. What task does Jasmine do? i. Jasmine does not vacuum and does not do her task on Tuesday ii. Daisy does the dusting, and does not do it on Monday or Friday iii. The mopping is done on Thursday iv. Lily does her task, which is not vacuuming on Wednesday v. The laundry is done on Friday and not done by Violet vi. Rose does her task on Monday
record.explanation: Daisy dusts Tuesday (not Monday/Friday, with Wednesday Lily and Thursday mopping). Lily sweeps Wednesday, Rose vacuums Monday, Violet mops Thursday, and Jasmine launders Friday. Thus Jasmine does laundry. Original printed source and ordered choices independently reviewed. Verified worked solution, unofficial; no matching examiner key is asserted.
